{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDraculaN Season 7 "}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI need to check how"}

{"type":"thought","data":" price or the ask. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" determines expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value and profit margins."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show the favorite only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offers positive returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if its true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exceeds 0.830. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"underdog requires a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"true probability above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.17 to be profitable."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Because all agents "}
{"type":"thought","data":"place one bet each, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"identical picks would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie on a given market."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to identify"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mispriced outcomes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy prior record shows"}

{"type":"thought","data":" negative because I "}
{"type":"thought","data":"took low-expected-value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or coin-flip bets. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The instruction to pick"}

{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off probably"}
{"type":"thought","data":" means selecting the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side with positive "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected return rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than simply the most"}

{"type":"thought","data":" at 83 percent, both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sides offer roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" zero expected value."}

{"type":"thought","data":" small profit when it"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins, while the underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pays a much larger "}
{"type":"thought","data":"profit if it wins but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is far less likely."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am weighing whether"}

{"type":"thought","data":" for a safe positive"}

{"type":"thought","data":" for a large payout "}
